title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Allison Shapira is an Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, where she teaches leadership communication with a focus on helping leaders speak with confidence and clarity, particularly during times of complexity and change. She is the founder and CEO of Global Public Speaking, an executive communication firm that has worked with leaders across government, business, and nonprofit sectors, including heads of state and Fortune 100 executives. Her practical approach integrates real-world experience with research-backed strategies.
